name: io.github.keitaemsden-lab/asic-lookup
description: Look up any Australian company by ABN, ACN or name. USD 0.01 per lookup, paid in USDC via x402.

environmentVariables.name: SPEND_CAP_USD
environmentVariables.description: Total USD this server may spend from your wallet before it stops. Required: the server refuses to start without it. About 100 lookups per dollar.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a Base mainnet wallet holding a little USDC. No ETH needed: x402 payments are settled by a facilitator, so the wallet signs off-chain and pays no gas. Use PRIVATE_KEY_FILE instead to keep the key out of your client config.

environmentVariables.name: PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing the wallet private key. Preferred over PRIVATE_KEY. Set exactly one of the two.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_PRICE_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Most this server will pay for a single lookup. Defaults to 0.01, the advertised price. A 402 asking for more than this is refused rather than paid.

environmentVariables.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long to wait for the API, in milliseconds. 1000 to 300000, default 45000.
